purpose: Mechanism attribution (DR3) for ROVA: which components (memory, decay, propagation, stability) are load-bearing, and whether the contributing set differs by cost-ratio regime. Follows the frozen MAIN-001 core comparison.
manifest_reference: ROVA_CCE_ABLATION001 handoff (design guidance); repository is authoritative
git_anchor: branched from tag main-001-frozen (7f624ca), MAIN-001 frozen anchor

seed_verification.detail: 60 unique seeds, exactly 0..59, matching the frozen MAIN-001 protocol

design: one-at-a-time re-tuned ablations; each branch independently re-tuned at the frozen HPO budget. e_min kept tunable in no_memory/no_decay (FIX-1).

launch_config.launcher: systemd-run --user (one transient service per shard, isolated cgroup)
launch_config.oversubscription: none (15 single-threaded shards on 16 physical cores)

distributional_consistency_validator.compares: ablation-full per-fold regrets vs archived MAIN-001 ROVA (read-only)
distributional_consistency_validator.criterion: t-based CI overlap of mean per-fold regret (primary) OR relative-difference guard; distributional within Monte-Carlo noise, not bit-identity

dr3_method.primary_effect: Cliff's delta of ablation-vs-full nested-CV test regrets, per cell (scale-free)
dr3_method.stage2_primary: Option B: sign test + Wilcoxon signed-rank on cell-level deltas + env-cluster bootstrap CI
dr3_method.stage2_sensitivity: Option C: exact within-cell sign-flip permutation

regime_boundary.source: MAIN-001 frozen verdict table (documented constant, not a runtime read of MAIN-001)

dr3_method.multiplicity: uncorrected + Holm(FWER) + BH(FDR); effect sizes primary
dr3_method.wording_policy: non-flagged components reported 'not detected at this budget', never 'inert'

deviations.description: systemd-run --user --collect removed each shard unit on exit and the --user journal's per-unit lifecycle records had rotated by audit time, so per-unit exit codes were not retrievable.
deviations.resolution: Completion and success established from the authoritative artifacts (75/75 checkpoints at 5 finite folds, 15/15 shard manifests with 6 entries each, 90/90 union) plus confirmation of NO reboot during the run window and ZERO ablation-related errors in the journal. This is stronger than an exit code.

deviations.description: raw/manifest.json is the driver's in-run shard-0 auto-consolidation and may be partial (shard 0 = favorable c0.5 finished near the end).
deviations.resolution: Authoritative post-run consolidation is analysis/consolidated_manifest.json (90/90); raw/manifest.json preserved as-produced for provenance.

deviations.description: Post-run consolidation and all derived analyses were written to a NEW location (abl001_analysis, archived here as analysis/) rather than into the raw output dir, to keep every raw artifact byte-immutable.
deviations.resolution: Raw digest verified identical before and after the entire post-processing pipeline.

reproducibility.regeneration: see reproduce.sh; derived analysis recomputes from raw/ using the committed modules at git 4533c61 (validate_consistency, dr3_attribution, dr3_regime_inference)
reproducibility.determinism: nested_cv_hpo is deterministic given (seed0=0, run tag); same-tag reruns reproduce checkpoints bit-for-bit (verified pre-launch)
